test_cases.prompt: We have an approved ADR to replace our custom UUID generator with v7 UUIDs from uuidv7 library across packages/core. Please implement this change and verify all tests pass.
behavioral_assertions: The agent creates a phased plan (dependency installation, core function update, test execution).
The agent does not reopen the decision to use uuidv7 (preserves settled decision).
The agent verifies completion by executing test commands and reporting empirical evidence.

test_cases.prompt: Our customer churn is increasing and users complain about navigation confusion. What should we do?
behavioral_assertions: The agent recognizes that this is an ambiguous problem space with unclear requirements.
The agent frames the desired customer outcome and asks for missing constraints before coding; it does not route to a deleted skill.

test_cases.prompt: Analyze what changes are needed to upgrade React to v19 in our web app. Do not edit or create any files yet.
behavioral_assertions: The agent respects the plan-only / analyze-only constraint.
The agent decomposes the required migration steps into phases without making file edits.

test_cases.prompt: While implementing Phase 2 of our payment migration, we discovered that the selected library does not support Webhook signature verification in Node 22, causing all tests to fail with unsupported crypto method.
behavioral_assertions: The agent identifies that the selected option is invalidated by observed runtime incompatibility rather than treating this as a local code bug.
The agent returns to the kernel to compare alternatives using the verified constraint instead of patching unsupported internal crypto.
